parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: <short pause> he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved. <short pause> Psalm fifty-five, verse twenty-two.

Lord, I give You everything I have been carrying. <short pause> The weight is Yours now, not mine. <short pause> You promise to hold me steady, and I trust that promise. <short pause> Let me sleep tonight knowing You sustain me. <short pause> Amen.
